title: An umbrella in the lost-and-found box
prompt: You volunteer at the front desk of a community centre in Surrey. A friend has told you that she left her umbrella at the centre last week. In the lost-and-found box, you find this unusual umbrella. Call your friend, describe it in detail, and ask whether it belongs to her.

structure: Say where you are and why you are calling (you may have found her umbrella).
Describe the canopy: the four coloured sections, the lights along the edge and the red tip.
Describe the lower part: the black pole, the silver ring, the purple handle and the strap.
Ask if it is hers and suggest how she can pick it up.
modelAnswer: Hi Sofia, it's me, calling from the community centre. You said you left your umbrella here last week, right? Well, I'm looking at one in the lost-and-found box, and it's pretty unusual, so let me describe it. It's open right now, and the top is shaped like a dome. It's divided into four sections. From left to right, the first one is yellow, the second is teal, the third is clear, so you can see right through it, and the last one is teal again. All along the bottom edge, there's a row of tiny white lights, a bit like Christmas lights. On the very top, there's a small red ball. The pole is black, and about halfway down, there's a silver ring sticking out to the right. I think it's a cup holder for your coffee. The handle is straight, not curved, and it's purple, with a black loop hanging from the end for your wrist. Does that sound like yours? If it is, I can keep it at the front desk until you come by.

commonMistakes: Nói 'transparent color' cho phần trong suốt; tự nhiên hơn là 'clear, so you can see right through it'.
Nhầm 'pole/shaft' (cán) với 'handle' (tay cầm); nếu không chắc hãy nói 'the long black part'.
Quên mục đích cuộc gọi: phải hỏi bạn xem có phải ô của bạn không và hẹn cách lấy lại.
